Alternate workflow manual city selection loads graphs and forecast without location detection
Boundary scenario empty city search remains editable without a London result
Negative scenario invalid city search does not offer London

Test Case Title: Toggle Temperature Unit to °F When Already Set to °F
Module: App Settings, Temperature and Display Configuration
Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- - The app is launched and the user is on the main screen.
- - The temperature unit is already set to °F in settings.

Test Steps:
1. Open the navigation drawer.
2. Tap on Settings.
3. Wait until General Settings is visible, then tap it.
4. Wait until the Temperature option is visible, then tap it.
5. Tap on °F (although °F is already selected).

Expected Result:
- - The temperature unit remains set to °F.
- - No visible change or reload occurs, and the option appears selected.
- - The app does not crash or show any error message.
- - The main view reflects °F as the temperature unit without any disruption. (Generated from Manual Test Case)

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Launch App and Complete Initial Setup Successfully
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Launch App and Complete Initial Setup Successfully
Module: Launch & Initial Setup
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - The app is installed on the Android device.
- - The device is turned on and connected to the internet.

Test Steps:
1. Launch the app from the device home screen or app drawer.
2. Wait for the app to finish loading.
3. Tap OK when the initial welcome or setup dialog appears.
4. Tap the Allow button to grant any required permissions.

Expected Result:
- - The app launches without crashing.
- - The initial setup dialog is displayed on the first launch.
- - The user is prompted for permissions, and on tapping Allow, the app transitions to the main screen or dashboard successfully.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Attempt to Search for a Location Without Entering Any Text
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Attempt to Search for a Location Without Entering Any Text
Module: Search for Location
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - The app is launched and the user is on the main screen.
- - All required permissions have been granted.

Test Steps:
1. Tap the Search icon on the main screen.
2. Wait for the Search location field to appear.
3. Attempt to tap on the Search location field and leave it empty.
4. Observe the results list or attempt to continue without entering any search term.

Expected Result:
- - The app should not display any results and should remain in the search input state.
- - If the search is attempted with an empty field, an appropriate validation message or no-action response is shown.
- - The app does not crash or proceed to a location result screen.
